definition.extra_delay_blocks: Additional completed test-timestamp batches withheld before a test batch can update the rolling calibration pool.  Delay 0 matches the ordinary batch-completion prequential update.
definition.rolling: Equal-weight conformal threshold over the most recent 1000 revealed nonconformity scores.
definition.static: Fixed empirical threshold from the final initial calibration interval; repeated across delay values only for paired summaries.
